d: A new project means fresh ideas, ambitious designs and plenty of work for the OCC crew! Step inside the Orange County Choppers workshop as Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the motorcycle builders get started on new custom chopper projects. From initial concepts and design decisions to fabrication and bike customization, discover what goes into turning an idea into an extraordinary motorcycle. Watch American Chopper Season 5 Episodes 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18 and 19 only on discovery+ India.
